events.observed_signal: The authoritative static repository test compared active Human Decision IDs with a closed terminal set ending at H22, so valid append-only H23-H25 growth could not pass without repeatedly editing the expected latest IDs.

correction.action: Replaced terminal equality with stable-anchor retention plus exact equality between discovered non-historical decisions and the validated active index; added complete future-chain acceptance and duplicate, malformed, orphan and unrelated-chain negatives in one cross-runtime-compatible test blob.

checks: extended-history checks remain present when supported

events.schema_impact: None; the production protocol and every coordination record schema remain unchanged.
events.quality_impact: Valid append-only growth no longer creates false-red CI while exact identity, provenance, chain, replay, branch and queue failures remain fail-closed.

learning.reusable_lesson: An append-only repository fixture must combine stable historical anchors with complete discovered-record equality; a terminal ID allowlist encodes time rather than protocol correctness.
learning.future_prevention: Test future valid growth synthetically and compare the validator index with all discovered non-historical records instead of updating a latest-ID set.

events.observed_signal: The exact authoritative bundle failed before the stale terminal assertion because H25 followed accepted V56 and was not listed by an exact-pinned proactive Human Decision migration.

correction.action: Added append-only KU2D-M-000006 with the exact Git blob identities of H25 and V56, preserving explicit human provenance without rewriting either record or relaxing the default review-chain rule.

events.schema_impact: None; KU2D-M-000006 uses the existing historical-migration v1 contract.
events.quality_impact: The explicit H25 decision becomes valid bundle evidence only for its exact immutable bytes; general unrequested Human Decisions remain rejected.

learning.reusable_lesson: A proactive Human Decision after a non-requesting review must be exact-pinned at append time or the complete bundle correctly fails closed.
learning.future_prevention: Validate the complete authoritative bundle immediately after every proactive Human Decision and create its exact-pinned migration in the same bounded coordination step.
